name: Letterhead
description: An A4 sheet with the lockup, a letter, and the address in the footer.

values.body:
Dear Sam,

Thank you for the notes on the second round. We have folded them into the drawings and the revised set is attached.

Two things worth a call before Friday:

- the entrance sign is now 30 mm shorter
- the small print moves to the reverse

With thanks,

presets.name: Warm paper
presets.description: Off-white stock with a rust accent.

presets.name: Second sheet
presets.description: The same furniture with no letter - the continuation page.
